message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on climbing nuts (brass head on stainless steel wire). The candidate headings are:

- 7419 (other articles of copper, which includes brass)
- 8302 (base metal mountings)
- 7326 (articles of iron or steel)
- 6506
- 9506.91 (articles for general physical exercise or athletics)
- 9506.99 (other sporting goods)

Climbing equipment such as carabiners has been classified in 9506.99. Chapter 95 covers sports equipment, and climbing protection devices are sports equipment not otherwise specified. Note 1 to Chapter 95 does not exclude base-metal articles here, since it excludes only certain items such as sails and sports clothing. I recall a CBP ruling that classified the "DDM Brass Climbing Nuts" under 9506.99.6080, "Other: Other: Other", but I am not certain of the exact statistical suffix. Another option is 9506.99.2000 for "Other: Other: Articles and equipment for other sports", but I think 9506.99.60 is the more likely one.

9506.99.6080 is "Other sporting goods: Other", which fits climbing nuts.
